exposure: Maternal age (35 years and above vs. 20-29 years)
cohort: 20 primipara women (13 aged 35 years and above, 7 aged 20-29 years) who delivered in a hospital in Japan.
finding: While older primiparas interacted more favorably with their children according to the NCATS caregiver scores, they experienced greater social isolation, overall stress, and their children showed greater hypersensitivity/lack of adaptability at 3 months.
